lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a crowdsourced geographic database maintained by volunteer contributors. The dataset was compiled and exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) with quality metrics indicating ~33% coverage of Rwanda's total building stock and an average data age of 3 years. The resulting vector geometries are provided in multiple formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) for disaster risk exposure assessment.
